cases.selection_rule: Up to three largest signed gains and losses under each stated diagnostic, ties by anonymous manifest order. All64 rows are published; these are not selected training/confirmation cases.

mechanism.final_mechanism_verdict: Requires joint interpretation of quality, actual over/undercoverage and both positive/negative cases; this helper does not decide.
mechanism.limitation: This attribution cannot establish that hull fusion is the main failure cause or that mixture improves MBR. The fixed second-round intervention is required; no tuning follows these labels.
mechanism.rule: Automatic descriptive hint only, fixed before labels: both effective-mass CIs below zero plus positive loss/overcoverage association; otherwise partial when either mean falls. These are not validated mechanism thresholds, a formal verdict, an adaptation gate or a reason to alter the two fixed rounds.
